en-US.title: Parking Picture
en-US.subtitle: Remember where you parked
en-US.description:
Never wander a parking garage again.

Parking Picture opens straight to the camera. Snap one photo of your parking spot — the floor number, a pillar, a sign — and it's saved instantly. When you come back, the photo is waiting on the same screen, with the time you took it.

• One tap to capture: the camera is live as soon as the app opens.
• Your last spot is always one glance away.
• Pinch or double-tap to zoom in on details like level numbers and row signs.
• Each new photo replaces the previous one, so there is nothing to manage or clean up.
• Private by design: the photo stays on your device. No account, no tracking, no internet connection required.
en-US.promoText: Snap your parking spot in one tap and find your car fast.
